verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an API-first inference service, so it runs headlessly by design. Requests are authenticated with an API key in `Authorization: Bearer` or `X-API-Key` headers, and the docs show cURL, Python and TypeScript calls through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, all of which suit unattended scripts and CI jobs. A published OpenAPI spec (probe-confirmed) also supports programmatic integration. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guidance (e.g., pipeline examples, service-account or scoped-key docs), rate-limit or retry behavior for unattended runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
